# Tenvor

> Tenvor is an open-model cloud: one OpenAI-compatible API for open models, served by GPUs in PCs around the world. Each request runs in a sealed container (no network, rootless, read-only model files). Pay per token; every new account gets $0.25 of free credit, no card needed. Operated by Tenvor Compute LLC.

- API: OpenAI-compatible. Change only the base URL and the key; the OpenAI SDKs, curl, JetBrains AI Assistant, OpenCode and Pi work.
- Model today: Qwen 3.6 35B (`chat-35b-moe`), 64K context, tool calls, reasoning and streaming.
- Pricing: $0.126 per million input tokens, $0.063 cached input, $0.81 per million output tokens. Failed requests are never billed. Monthly plans: Lite $6, Plus $12.50, Max $19.
- Data: requests are never logged or kept; a request's files are erased when it finishes. The node operator can read the prompt, so keep sensitive data out during the alpha.
- Operators: anyone invited can run a node on an NVIDIA GPU with 10 GB+ of video memory (Windows 11 or Linux).
- Contact: support@tenvor.io. Security reports: security@tenvor.io.
